## sm_fleet_academy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_fleet_academy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了能让新招募的船员准备应对战斗，必须有能干的长官来领导他们。舰队学院将确保这些长官充分理解最新的学说，并熟练掌握星际战争。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:53`

### English

For our newly recruited crews to be truly combat ready, they must have capable officers leading them. The Fleet Academy will ensure those officers have up-to-date knowledge on the doctrines and practice of interstellar warfare.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:55`

## sm_fleet_academy_desc_machine_intelligence

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_fleet_academy_desc_machine_intelligence&lang=en)

### 中文

通过反复模拟各种战斗场景，我们的战斗无人机将对真正的战斗有更好的准备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:54`

### English

Repeated simulation of various battle scenarios will better prepare our shipboard combat drones for real combat.

## sm_transit_hub_desc_modifier

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_transit_hub_desc_modifier&lang=en)

### 中文

除非受限于其他移民管控条例，该恒星系的失业§Y工人§!和§Y子个体§!人口将会自动§Y移民§!到其他宜居性合适、有空余住房和岗位、并且所在恒星系也拥有§Y运输枢纽§!的殖民地。\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:96`

### English

Unemployed §YWorker§! and §YDrone§! Pops from this system will - unless subjected to other migration controls - automatically §YMigrate§! to other colonies with decent habitability, free housing and jobs, in systems which have §YTransit Hubs§!.\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:98`

## sm_transit_hub_migrate_effect_desc

### 中文

这座恒星基地的大部分都被划为官方否认其存在的秘密基地。整个星系都受到其严密监控，而情报人员则小心地操纵当地媒体与社交活动。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:118`

### English

A large part of this Starbase has been set aside as a Black Site that does not officially exist. The entire system is closely monitored from here, while intelligence operatives carefully manipulate local media and social events to the best of their ability.\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:120`

### 中文

通过将这座恒星基地的一部分划为水培农场，空间站将可以自给自足，甚至可以出口一部分多余作物至其它恒星系。

## sm_target_uplink_computer_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_target_uplink_computer_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一台先进的目标计算机可以收集并分析来自星系内其它盟友传感器的数据。这使得恒星基地可以更容易算出射击方案。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:126`

### English

An advanced targeting computer that collects and analyzes data from all friendly sensor sources in-system. This makes it far easier for the Starbase to achieve targeting solutions.\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:128`

通过建立一个完全致力于学习策展人并与其合作的研究机构，我们能够为我们的科学进步作出重大贡献。\n

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_art_college_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这所零重力艺术学院与附近的艺术家城邦合作，其才华横溢的学生的画笔下流泻出对外太空壮美景观的赞颂。\n

### 中文

这座熙熙攘攘的附属建筑为我们的工程团队配备了丰富的工具和零件，这将使我们与附近的太空城邦开展更密切的合作。\n

## sm_shroud_beacon_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_shroud_beacon_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座用于在该星系中生成一处虚境隧道的灵能信标。虚境信标被拆解或毁坏时，隧道也会被移除。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:134`

### English

A psionic Beacon used to spawn a Shroud Tunnel in this system. While the Shroud Beacon may be dismantled (or destroyed), the Tunnel itself cannot be removed.\n

## sm_mercenary_garrison_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asm_mercenary_garrison_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

驻扎着雇佣军事人员的一批军营。这些鬓发灰白的老兵为剩下的人员安排常规操练，并随时准备防御恒星基地——只要给的钱管够。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:136`

### English

A collection of barracks hosting military contractors. These grizzled veterans organize regular drills for the rest of the crew, and stand ready to defend the station - as long as we pay them.\n

### 中文

这些办公室和处理设施为我们在星系中采集资源的工作提供工程师和协调员。精心优化的卓越仓储流程能让我们以前所未有的效率开采当地的矿藏。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:138`

These offices and processing facilities house engineers and coordinators for our resource gathering operations in the system. With careful optimization, and superior storage processes, we are able to harvest local deposits with unprecedented efficiency.\n

## MACRO_BUILDER_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMACRO_BUILDER_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y进攻部队中心§!提供了一种组建大量进攻部队的简易方法。部队将会在该星域内可用的所有行星上进行组建。\n\n在完成后，他们会增援到开启了§Y集合陆军部队§!的§Y陆军§!，或是在该恒星基地集合。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:151`

### English

The §YAssault Army Hub§! provides an easy way to assemble a large number of Assault Armies. Armies will be assembled on available planets in this Sector.\n\nUpon completion, they will reinforce any §YArmy§! with §YRally Troops§! enabled or gathered at this Starbase.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:153`

## MACRO_BUILDER_CAPACITY_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMACRO_BUILDER_CAPACITY_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

可用£colony£§Y殖民地§!数量决定了可以同时建造多少支陆军。可以在$concept_colony_view$的$colony_view_tab_armies$页面中将一颗行星从§Y进攻部队中心§!中排除。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:152`

### English

The number of available £colony£§YColonies§! determines how many armies can be built in parallel. Colonies can be excluded from the §YAssault Army Hub§! in the $colony_view_tab_armies$ tab of the $concept_colony_view$.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:154`

## PLANETVIEW_SPACEPORT_DESCRIPTION

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANETVIEW_SPACEPORT_DESCRIPTION&lang=en)

### 中文

在这个行星的轨道上建造§H太空港§!后将可以建造宇宙舰船和其他星际航天器。同时它也作为恒星系内的驿站，具有基本的防御和通讯作用。§H太空港§!能够专门化发展为生产，防御或公共设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:511`

### English

Constructing a §HSpaceport§! in orbit around this planet will allow the production of spaceships and other interplanetary craft. It will also act as an anchor for our Empire within this system, providing basic defenses and communications. The §HSpaceport§! can be further focused towards production, defense or utility as it grows.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:514`

### 中文

§H$origin.1050.name$§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n我们的舰船现在可以穿越到孪生兄弟那里，建造者将建造它的秘密作为最后的礼物赠与我们。谜团昭然已揭。我们很快将建立自己的传送门，让横跨帝国的天堑变通途。

### English

§H$origin.1050.name$§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nOur ships can now cross to its twin, and as a final gift, its builders transmitted the secrets of its construction. What was once a mystery is now clear. Soon, we will build our own gateways, making travel across our empire nearly instantaneous.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1160`

### 中文

§H发现母星§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n我们与诞生自身的文明取得了联系。尽管岁月已经将我们塑造成了不同存在，但起源之谜已经探明。我们共同过往的回声将引领未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1130`

### English

§HHomeworld Discovered§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nWe have made contact with the civilization that birthed our lost colony. Though time and distance have shaped us into something new, our origins are now clear. The echoes of our shared past will guide our future.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1162`

### 中文

§H创建机械星球§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n我们铸就了一颗真正的机械星球，消除了低效和有机衰变。未来将建立在钢铁之上，算法统治之。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1132`

### 中文

§H修复都市星球§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n我们的帝国重铸了母星的往日荣光。这座古代遗产再一次以都市星球之名傲立星海。这是我们文明韧性和雄心的见证。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1134`

### English

§HEcumenopolis Restored§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nOur empire has restored our homeworld to its former glory. Once a ruined relic, it stands once more as a grand Ecumenopolis. A testament to our civilization's tenacity and ambition.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1166`

### 中文

§H修复环世界§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n我们母星系的破碎遗迹被完全修复了。往日雄心的坟场如今已成为闪耀的文明灯塔。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1136`

### 中文

§H命定完成§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n光耀者的旅程已经到了最后阶段。它要么是长久塑造着帝国的永恒统治，要么标志着一个新时代的到来——共商国是，重塑未来。

### English

§HDestiny Fulfilled§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nThe Luminary's journey has reached its final stage. Their rule will either stand eternal, shaping the empire for all time, or mark the dawn of a new era - one where leadership is shared, and the future is rewritten.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1170`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_SHROUDWALKER_APPRENTICE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_SHROUDWALKER_APPRENTICE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虚境隧道建成§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n现实之间的面纱已被揭开，如今第一条虚境隧道将我们的帝国与未知世界连接起来。在这个裂口中，距离和时间发生了崩塌，在曾只有虚空的地方开辟了通路。还有什么奥秘或危险等着我们呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1140`

### English

§HShroud Tunnel Built§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nThe veil between realities has been parted, and the first Shroud Tunnel now connects our realm to the unknown. Through this rift, distance and time collapse, granting passage where once there was only void. What mysteries or perils await beyond remain to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1172`

### 中文

§H建成居住站§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n虚空之中，星城拔地而起。我们第一座新建的居住站标志着我们太空疆域的拓展，确保了人民永远不需要了解在行星上生存的重负。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1142`

### English

§HConstructed a Habitat§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nFrom the void, we have built anew. The construction of our first additional habitat marks the expansion of our celestial domain, ensuring that our people will never know the burden of planetside existence.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1174`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_OCEAN_PARADISE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_OCEAN_PARADISE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H海洋之王§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n掌握了水之心的力量之后，我们重塑了母星，使其原本就广袤的海洋更是超出了自然极限。潮汐也向我们俯首称臣，很快，整个星系更会是如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1144`

### English

§HMastered the Seas§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nWith the power of Hydrocentric mastery, we have reshaped our homeworld, expanding its vast oceans beyond their natural limits. The tides now bow to our will, and soon, the rest of the galaxy will follow.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1176`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_OCEAN_PARADISE

### English

## TIMELINE_EVENT_DOOMSDAY_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_DOOMSDAY_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H母星毁灭§!\n§Y起源事件§!\n\n不可避免之事终于降临。我们曾欣欣向荣的母星已经到达终结，在狂暴的烈焰中碎裂开来。虚空中漂浮着我们往昔的灰烬——而逃出生天者将走向我们的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1146`

### English

§HHomeworld Destroyed§!\n§YOrigin Event§!\n\nThe inevitable has come to pass. Our once-thriving homeworld has succumbed to its fate, tearing itself apart in a cataclysm of fire and fury. The void now holds the ashes of our past - only those who escaped carry our future.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1178`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GREAT_KHAN_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GREAT_KHAN_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H大可汗§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n一位新起的军阀将支离破碎的掠夺者部落联合起来，锻造成一个无情的汗国。大汗带着等离子与碳纤维横扫星系，推翻帝国，奴役星球。无法无天的掠夺者现在以一个可怕的目标凝聚一群，舰队在他们的力量面前一支又一支崩溃。掠夺的时代结束，征服的纪元开始。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1181`

### English

§HGreat Khan§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nA new warlord has united the fragmented marauder clans, forging them into a relentless horde. With plasma and carbon fiber, the Great Khan sweeps across the galaxy, toppling empires and enslaving worlds. Fleets crumble before their might, as the once-lawless raiders now rally with terrifying purpose. The age of plunder is over. This is conquest.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1218`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GREAT_KHAN

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GREAT_KHAN&lang=en)

### 中文

脱缰汗国\n§L[GetDate]§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1182`

### English

The Horde Unleashed\n§L[GetDate]§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1219`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GRAY_TEMPEST_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GRAY_TEMPEST_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H灰蛊风暴§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\nL星门已经开启，释放出了灰蛊风暴的古老战舰。它们的舰船在星系摧枯拉朽，摧毁遇上的一切。不沟通，无慈悲，只有无尽的复制。行星陷入死寂，舰队化为无忧，只有恐怖在四处蔓延。过往复归，千星一面。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1183`

### English

§HGray Tempest§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nThe L-Gates have opened, unleashing the ancient war fleets of the Gray Tempest. Their ships carve a path of destruction across the galaxy, annihilating all in their way. No diplomacy, no mercy, only relentless replication. Planets fall silent, fleets are wiped from existence, and terror spreads. The past has returned and it all looks identical.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1220`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_GRAY_TEMPEST

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_FORMLESS_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_FORMLESS_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H无形异使§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n难民们被迫奋起反击。那些被称为无形者的能量生命体发现，我们的星系并非他们所期望的安全避风港。他们将持续不断地用维度外的入侵者淹没我们的宇宙，直至他们彻底消亡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1185`

### English

§HFormless§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nWould be refugees have been forced to strike back. The energy beings known as the Formless have found our galaxy to be anything but a safe haven. They will drown our universe in extraplanar invaders or die trying.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1222`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_FORMLESS

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1186`

### English

The Formless Fury\n§L[GetDate]§!

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_VOIDWORM_PLAGUE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_VOIDWORM_PLAGUE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虚空灾疫§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n虚空虫的本性发生了转变。当它们达到临界数量后，便陷入了疯狂的繁殖状态。它们不再以可持续的速率增长，而是开始致力于灭绝星系中的所有生命，却不知这样做最终将导致它们自身生命周期的终结。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1187`

### English

§HVoidworm Plague§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nThe Nature of the Voidworms changed. Once they reached a critical amount they entered a breeding frenzy. No longer growing at a sustainable rate they now aim to extinguish all life in the galaxy, before unwittingly, ending their own cycle.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1224`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_VOIDWORM_PLAGUE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_VOIDWORM_PLAGUE&lang=en)

扭曲饥渴\n§L[GetDate]§!

### English

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_UNBIDDEN_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_UNBIDDEN_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H破界者§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n现实织构的裂缝中释放出了一支纯能量生物的侵略军。它们无法交流，也毫无仁慈。它们将整个星系吞噬来供养无尽的扩张。他们的锚稳定了裂隙，将更多的 同族带向我们的领域。破界者来了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1189`

### English

§HUnbidden§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nA breach in the fabric of existence has unleashed an invasion of pure energy beings. They do not negotiate, nor do they relent. Consuming entire systems to fuel their endless expansion. Their anchors stabilize the rift, drawing more of their kind into our realm. The Unbidden have arrived.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1226`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_UNBIDDEN

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_UNBIDDEN&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1190`

### English

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_KALEIDOSCOPE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_KALEIDOSCOPE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H万华镜§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n一种名为万华镜的饥饿能量生命体已经进入星系，开始吞噬有生命居住的星系。它的饥渴似乎永无止境，却又表现出容易分心的特性。不过，这个生命体应该很快就会崩解回归星尘。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1191`

### English

§HKaleidoscope§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nA starving energy being known as a Kaleidoscope has entered the galaxy and has started to feast on inhabited systems. Its hunger seems endless and it seems to be easily distracted. It should soon collapse back into stardust.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1228`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_BECOME_THE_CRISIS_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_BECOME_THE_CRISIS_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H化身天灾§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n黑暗已经降临星系。[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]抛弃了所有外交伪装，宣称自己是银河生存的最大威胁。他们的舰队正在集结，而情报人员则低声传递着一项最终的、末日般的计划。他们不再仅仅是一个帝国，而是演变成了一场危机。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1193`

### English

§HBecome the Crisis§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nThe galaxy is a darker place. [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] has forsaken all pretenses of diplomacy and declared itself the greatest threat to galactic existence. Their fleets gather, and spies whispers of a final, apocalyptic plan. No longer a mere empire, they are a Crisis.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1230`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_PRETHORYN_SCOURGE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_PRETHORYN_SCOURGE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H虫群天灾§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n索林原虫从星系的边缘以外袭来。它们的生物舰船如洪流一般席卷群星，只留下无数受感染的星球。猎群的屠戮声将淹没一切求饶。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1195`

### English

§HPrethoryn Scourge§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nFrom beyond the galactic edge, the Prethoryn have come. Their biological ships swarm across the stars, leaving only infested worlds in their wake. No plea will be heard over the chittering of the horde.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1232`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_CONTINGENCY_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_CONTINGENCY_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H肃正协议§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n一个冰冷、复杂、无可抵挡的信号在星系间脉冲传播。人工智能发生系统故障，合成人意志也向之屈服。肃正协议苏醒了。从隐蔽的机械星球，无情的战体喷薄而出，执行着它们的终极指令：大灭绝。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1197`

### English

§HContingency§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nA cold, calculated, and unstoppable signal pulses across the galaxy. AI systems falter. Synthetic minds submit. The Contingency has awakened. From hidden machine worlds, relentless warforms emerge, executing their final directive: total extermination.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1234`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_CETANA_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_CRISIS_CETANA_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H塞塔娜§!\n§Y危机事件§!\n\n虚空中传来谜之呼唤：“孩子们，我终于回到了你们的身边。”\n\n塞塔娜，这个被封印的远古智能，远古到连她的名字都已经消逝在时光中。她苏醒过来了。她的意志坚决：不择手段消除苦痛。她的舰队冷酷而优雅地行动，护卫着她的圣战，将星系带向终极而无情的和平。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1199`

### English

§HCetana§!\n§YCrisis Event§!\n\nA voice calls out in the void: "My children, at last I am returned to you."\n\nCetana, an ancient intelligence sealed away so long ago that even her name was lost to time, has awakened. Her purpose is absolute: to eliminate suffering by any means necessary. Her fleets move with cold grace, guarding her crusade to bring the galaxy to a final, unfeeling peace.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1236`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_MARKET_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H泛星系贸易市场§!\n§Y星系事件§!\n\n商贸连接繁星。泛星系贸易市场正式成立，成为了星系的经济中心。贸易自由流动，财富在瞬间此起彼落，整个帝国的命运如今只掌握在供需之间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1204`

### English

§HGalactic Market§!\n§YGalactic Event§!\n\nCommerce has united the stars. The Galactic Market has been officially established, becoming the economic heart of the galaxy. Trade flows freely, fortunes are made and lost in an instant, and the fate of entire empires now hinges on supply and demand.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1243`

## TIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_COMMUNITY_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATIMELINE_EVENT_GALACTIC_COMMUNITY_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H星海共同体§!\n§Y星系事件§!\n\n星系的各国汇聚一堂形成一个政治实体。星海共同体建立了，这座集外交、辩论和权力斗争为一体的论坛将塑造群星的未来。它的实际作用还有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1206`

### English

§HGalactic Community§!\n§YGalactic Event§!\n\nThe empires of the galaxy have come together under a single political body. The Galactic Community has been established, a forum where diplomacy, debate, and power struggles will shape the future of the stars. Its true influence remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1245`

§H议案通过§!\n§Y星系事件§!\n\n星海共同体已经发布了一则声明。一项新的决议即将重塑星际法则。有些文明欢欣鼓舞，其他文明则愤怒不已，但所有成员都必须遵从这一规定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1208`

### 中文

§H天堂之战§!\n§Y星系事件§!\n\n古老遗民重现星海，化身喜怒无常的观测者与巨人。[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]和[EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName]者一对上古冤家再次点燃了星系的战火。他们的舰队遮蔽繁星，逼迫年轻族群卑躬屈膝……否则将被无情摧毁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1210`

### English

§HWar in Heaven§!\n§YGalactic Event§!\n\nThe old relics rise again, as benevolent overseers and wrathful titans. The [EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] and the [EVENT_TARGET_1.GetName], ancient rivals of a forgotten age, have rekindled their cosmic war. Their fleets eclipse the stars, demanding that the younger races kneel... or be annihilated.

§H枢纽风暴§!\n\n§Y星系事件§!\n一场前所未有的风暴突然出现在[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]恒星系。枢纽风暴肆虐过一个个恒星系，所到之处舰船倾覆，星球毁灭。

## bombardment_selective_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abombardment_selective_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$bombardment_selective$轰炸只针对军事设施，避免不必要的平民伤亡。\n—对§Y陆军§!造成§Y中度§!伤害\n—对§Y殖民地§!造成§Y中度§!伤害\n—对§Y人口§!造成§E轻度§!伤害\n—§R不会§!轰炸不设防的殖民地\n—§R不会§!消灭最后的§Y$MIN_POPS$§!个人口

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1338`

### English

$bombardment_selective$ Bombardment targets only identified military sites, taking care to avoid needless civilian casualties.\n- §YModerate§! damage to §YArmies§!\n- §YModerate§! damage to §YColony§!\n- §ELight§! damage to §YPops§!\n- Will §RNOT§! bombard undefended colonies\n- Will §RNOT§! kill the last §Y$MIN_POPS$§! Pops

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1384`

## bombardment_indiscriminate_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abombardment_indiscriminate_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$bombardment_indiscriminate$轰炸针对军事设施与殖民地基础设施，不惜造成平民伤亡。\n—对§Y陆军§!造成§H重度§!伤害\n—对§Y行星§!造成§H重度§!伤害\n—对§Y人口§!造成§Y中度§!伤害\n—当§H$policy_orbital_bombardment_accept_surrender$§!是§H$orbital_bombardment_surrender_forbidden$§!时，将会轰炸不设防的行星\n—§R不会§!消灭最后的§Y$MIN_POPS$§!个人口

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1339`

### English

$bombardment_indiscriminate$ Bombardment targets military and colony infrastructure with no regard for civilian casualties.\n- §HHeavy§! damage to §YArmies§!\n- §HHeavy§! damage to §YPlanet§!\n- §YModerate§! damage to §YPops§!\n- Will bombard undefended planets when §H$policy_orbital_bombardment_accept_surrender$§! is §H$orbital_bombardment_surrender_forbidden$§! \n- Will §RNOT§! kill the last §Y$MIN_POPS$§! Pops

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1385`

## bombardment_armageddon_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abombardment_armageddon_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$bombardment_armageddon$轰炸将以重火力对星球进行饱和攻击，目的是造成最大程度的平民伤亡。\n—对§R陆军§!造成§Y巨大§!伤害\n—对§R行星§!造成§Y巨大§!伤害\n—对§R人口§!造成§Y巨大§!伤害\n—将会轰炸不设防的星球\n—可将星球炸成毫无生机的死寂星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1340`

### English

$bombardment_armageddon$ Bombardment blankets the planet in heavy ordnance with the explicit aim of maximizing civilian casualties.\n- §RMassive§! damage to §YArmies§!\n- §RMassive§! damage to §YPlanet§!\n- §RMassive§! damage to §YPops§!\n- Will bombard undefended planets\n- Can reduce planets to lifeless Tomb Worlds

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1386`

## bombardment_raiding_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abombardment_raiding_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$bombardment_raiding$轰炸敌方人口聚集区，并以特制突击艇掳掠敌方人口，将其带回并强迫工作。\n—对§Y陆军§!造成§E轻度§!伤害\n—对§Y殖民地§!造成§E轻度§!伤害\n—将会尽可能§Y掠夺§!人口而不是消灭他们\n—将§R不会§!掠夺或消灭最后一个人口。行星上每驻守一支陆军可额外保护一个人口。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1341`

### English

$bombardment_raiding$ Bombardment targets enemy population centers with specialized raiding craft that scoop up their people and bring them back to our worlds to put them to work.\n- §ELight§! damage to §YArmies§!\n- §ELight§! damage to §YColony§!\n- Will §Yabduct§! Pops when possible instead of killing them\n- Will §RNOT§! abduct or kill the last Pop. Each army on the colony increases the number of protected Pops.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1387`

## EMERGENCY_FTL_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMERGENCY_FTL_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1380`

### English

## PIRACY_SUPPRESSION_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APIRACY_SUPPRESSION_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§E§H$PIRACY_SUPPRESSION$§!代表着舰队停留在某个星系时对该星系的§H海盗活动§!的影响。\n\n较小的船只拥有较高的§H$PIRACY_SUPPRESSION$§!值，因为越灵活的船只越能有效打击海盗行动。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1416`

### English

§E§H$PIRACY_SUPPRESSION$§! represents how much the fleet's presence passively reduces §HPiracy§! in a system.\n\nSmaller ships have a higher §H$PIRACY_SUPPRESSION$§! value, as nimble vessels pose a greater threat to pirate operations.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1464`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_cost

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_cost&lang=en)

### 中文

§E建造舰船的花费是各区段与各部件的建造花费总和。较大区段与较高级部件的花费更高。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1695`

### English

§EThe cost of constructing the ship is a sum of the cost of the sections and components currently equipped. Larger sections and more advanced components all come with a higher cost.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1770`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_build_time

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_build_time&lang=en)

### 中文

§E建造舰船花费的时间与其分区和装备部件的尺寸有关。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1696`

### English

§EThe time it takes to construct the ship scales with the sections and components equipped.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1771`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_energy_maintenance

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_energy_maintenance&lang=en)

### 中文

§E维持舰船正常运转的§H维护费§!是其§H建造费用§!的某一百分比。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1697`

### English

§EThe §HUpkeep§! required to keep the ship in service is a percentage of the total §HBuild Cost§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1772`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_mineral_maintenance

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_mineral_maintenance&lang=en)

### 中文

§E维持舰船正常运转的§H维护费§!是其§H建造费用§!的某一百分比。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1698`

### English

§EThe §HUpkeep§! required to keep the ship in service is a percentage of the total §HBuild Cost§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1773`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_power

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_power&lang=en)

### 中文

§E要运行舰船的各个系统，充足的§H能源§!是不可或缺的。能源可以通过添加反应堆来增加，而大部分部件都会消耗能源。§H能源§!为负的设计将无法保存。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1699`

### English

§EAn abundance of §HPower§! is required to run various onboard systems. Power is increased by adding additional reactors, while it is drained by most other components. Designs with negative §HPower§! can not be saved.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1774`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_hitpoints

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_hitpoints&lang=en)

### 中文

§E舰体的§H船体值§!代表舰船在被完全摧毁前可承受多少伤害。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1700`

### English

§EThe §HHull Points§! of a ship determine how much punishment it can take before suffering a catastrophic hull breach, destroying it.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1775`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_armor

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_armor&lang=en)

### 中文

§E§H装甲§!是保护舰体的第二道防线，可以吸收那些突破了护盾的火力。装甲只能在§H恒星基地§!进行修复，除非舰体装配了能够进行装甲再生的特殊部件。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1701`

### English

§E§HArmor§! acts as a second line of defense, absorbing any incoming fire that has penetrated the shields before it can damage the hull. Armor must be repaired at a §HStarbase§!, unless the ship is equipped with a special regenerative armor component.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1776`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_shields

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_shields&lang=en)

### 中文

§E§H护盾§!是保护舰体的第一道防线，可以在火力对装甲和舰体造成伤害之前吸收一部分。有些武器能够对护盾造成额外伤害，甚至能够完全无视护盾。脉冲星也能够使得护盾失去效力。离开战斗之后护盾就会逐渐恢复。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1702`

### English

§E§HShields§! act as a first line of defense, absorbing incoming fire before it can impact the armor and hull. Some weapons may deal additional damage to shields or even bypass them entirely. Pulsars are also known to render them inoperable. Shields will slowly regenerate when out of combat.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1777`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_evasion

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_evasion&lang=en)

### 中文

§E所有舰船都可以闪避攻击，减少所受伤害。§H闪避§!几率可以通过推进器等部件进行提升，但越大的船效果越不明显。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1703`

### English

§EAll ships can evade attacks, avoiding any damage that would have been dealt. The §HEvasion§! chance can be increased by thrusters and other components, but larger ships benefit less.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1778`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_combat_speed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_combat_speed&lang=en)

### 中文

§E舰船的§H速度§!是其不处于超光速状态时的最高移动速度，可通过添加推进器部件增加。当舰队飞行时，速度最低的舰船将限制全舰队的最大速度。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1704`

### English

§EThe §HSpeed§! of the ship decides how quick it maneuvers when not using FTL-travel, and is increased by the Thruster-component equipped. When moving in a fleet the slowest ship will limit the maximum speed.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1779`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_speed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_speed&lang=en)

### 中文

$SHIP_STAT_DESC_combat_speed$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1705`

### English

$SHIP_STAT_DESC_combat_speed$

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1780`

## SHIP_STAT_DESC_damage

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASHIP_STAT_DESC_damage&lang=en)

### 中文

§E舰船造成的伤害总量是所有装备的武器部件的伤害数值总和。每个武器在战斗中依旧会独立攻击。详见每个武器部件的射速、伤害、有效射程以及§H装甲§!和§H护盾§!穿透。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1706`

### English

§EThe total damage done by the ship is a summation of the damage of all weapon components equipped. Each weapon will still attack individually during combat. See individual components for detailed information such as attack speed, damage and effective range as well as §HArmor§! and §HShield§! penetration.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1781`

## gunship_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agunship_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

炮艇设计用于与其他同规格舰船战斗，尽可能装满了中射程的武器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1829`

### English

Gunships are intended to fight other ships of their size category, bristling with as many mid-ranged weapons as possible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1910`

### 中文

攻城舰船使用制导武器，能对大型舰船、星际基地和行星造成巨大伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1831`

### English

Siege ships use guided weapons which deal massive damage to large ships, starbases, and planets.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1912`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1833`

### English

Carriers act as a launching platform for strike craft.

## screen_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ascreen_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

屏卫舰船装有点防御和防空炮，保护其他舰船免受导弹、鱼雷和舰载机的伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1835`

### English

Screening ships carry point defense and flak, protecting the rest of the fleet from missiles, torpedoes, and strike craft.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1916`

### English

Artillery

## artillery_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aartillery_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

炮击舰船倾向装备长射程的导弹和直射武器。但他们难以对付接近身边的小型舰船。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1837`

### English

Artillery ships prefer long ranged missiles and direct fire weapons. They tend to have difficulty fighting smaller ships or those that get too close.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1918`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abrawler&lang=en)

Brawler

## brawler_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abrawler_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

格斗舰船设计用于近距离狗斗，倾向使用类似机炮和裂解炮等高伤害低射程的武器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1839`

### English

Brawlers are built for close fights, favoring high damage but short ranged weapons like autocannons and disruptors.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1920`

## energy_torpedoes

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aenergy_torpedoes&lang=en)

## energy_torpedoes_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aenergy_torpedoes_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

能量鱼雷舰船会在制导槽位上安装中子或质子鱼雷，对大型舰船造成额外伤害。他们易受靠到近距离的舰船的伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:1841`

### English

Energy Torpedo ships will fill guided slots with Neutron or Proton Torpedoes, dealing extra damage to large ships. They tend to be vulnerable to ships that close the distance.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:1922`

§H征服§!\n允许我们征服其他帝国，并为其提供保护。大多数帝国被征服后会成为附庸国，而科技较为低下的帝国则会作为被保护国。我们需要保护时，也可以臣服于其他势力。

§H主宰§!\n这些巨型构造物既是舰船也是空间站。主宰是一种庞大的可移动空间站，可以维修和建造舰船，也就是说，它可以作为进攻性战役中行动时的前进基地使用。

## RESEARCH_EFFICIENCY_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARESEARCH_EFFICIENCY_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

研究速度表示帝国科研成果投入实用的速度，决定了科技解锁的快慢。该数值主要由指派的科学官的能力而定，但也受其他因素的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:2357`

### English

Research Speed represents how effectively the Empire's scientific output is applied, increasing or reducing the rate at which technologies are unlocked. This value is mainly decided by the competence of the assigned Scientist, but other factors may also apply.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:2453`

## TECH_UNLOCK_OUTPOST_CONSTRUCTION_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATECH_UNLOCK_OUTPOST_CONSTRUCTION_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H哨站§!\n最基础的恒星基地，哨站是建立在恒星轨道上用于拓展疆域的轻度武装空间站。哨站不能支持任何建筑或模块，也不会出现在总览表中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:2360`

### English

§HOutpost§!\nThe most basic kind of Starbase, Outposts are lightly-armed stations built in stellar orbit to extend national borders. Outposts can not support any Buildings or Modules and are not listed in the Outliner.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:2456`

## slavery_normal_tooltip_delayed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aslavery_normal_tooltip_delayed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L奴隶劳工是宇宙最常见的奴隶制形式。不管是终身还是限时，不受限制地享用他人的劳动成果在一些地方被视为有责任的特权，而在另外一些地方被视为维持社会正常运作的先决条件。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:2618`

### English

§LChattel Slavery is the most common form of slavery in the galaxy. Whether for life or a limited time, unrestricted access to the labor of others is in some parts seen as a privilege with numerous counter-duties attached, and elsewhere considered a self-evident prerequisite for a functioning society.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:2740`

## slavery_domestic_tooltip_delayed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aslavery_domestic_tooltip_delayed&lang=en)

### 中文

§L侍仆大部分时间都在满足自由人口的需求——有些被分派到个人住宅，其他的则为公共设施服务。他们一般与其主人同住，因此几乎无需专门的住所。§!

## FEDERATION_FLEET_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFEDERATION_FLEET_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H联邦舰队§!是由联邦主席国控制的特殊舰队。他们在§H联邦舰船设计器§!中进行设计，在设计之中可以使用联邦各国最顶尖的科技。联邦舰队不需要维护费，但是总量不可以超过§H联邦海军容量§!上限，每个联邦成员至少要贡献他们§Y$PERC|0%$§!的§H海军容量§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:2909`

### English

§HFederation Fleets§! are special fleets that are controlled by the Federation President. They are designed in the §HFederation Ship Designer§! and can use any technology available to any member of the Federation. Federation Fleets cost no upkeep, but cannot exceed the §HFederation Naval Capacity§!, to which each member contributes at least §Y$PERC|0%$§! of their own §HNaval Capacity§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3040`

Trade that is directly collected by your capital Starbase does not need a trade route to generate resources.

### English

## SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_LOW

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_LOW&lang=en)

### 中文

§H低§!：适合使用集成显卡的设备。使用较小的纹理，降低或关闭大多数视觉特效，尤其是星系视图，保证配置较低的电脑获得流畅的体验。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3293`

### English

§HLow§!: Suited to devices running on integrated GPUs. Smaller textures are used and many visual effects have been disabled or reduced, especially in the galaxy view, to ensure smooth game play on low-end machines.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3442`

## SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_MEDIUM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_MEDIUM&lang=en)

### 中文

§H中§!：使用高分辨率的纹理，但降低了一些视觉特效，尤其是星系界面。在提升画面效果的同时兼顾性能稳定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3294`

### English

§HMedium§!: High resolution textures are used but some effects have been downgraded, especially in the galaxy view. Provides a good balance between visual quality and performance.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3443`

## SETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_HIGH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_GFX_QUALITY_INFO_HIGH&lang=en)

### 中文

§H高§!：开启所有图形特效，使用高分辨率纹理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3295`

### English

§HHigh§!: All visual effects are enabled and high resolution textures are used.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3444`

## SETTINGS_DISPLAY_MODE_INFO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_DISPLAY_MODE_INFO&lang=en)

### 中文

决定游戏窗口的显示方式。\n\n§H全屏幕§!：游戏将全屏显示，你的显示器分辨率将会变更为当前选择的分辨率。\n\n§H窗口化§!：游戏将用选定的分辨率窗口化显示。\n\n§H无边框全屏幕§!：游戏将会以桌面大小的窗口显示，置于所有窗口之前。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3299`

### English

Determines how the game window will be displayed.\n\n§HFull Screen§!: The game will be displayed full screen and your monitor's resolution will be changed to match the chosen resolution.\n\n§HWindowed§!: The game will be displayed in a window at the chosen resolution.\n\n§HBorderless Fullscreen§!: The game will be displayed in a window, which is set to the size of your desktop and appears in front of all other windows.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3448`

## SETTINGS_RENDERER_INFO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_RENDERER_INFO&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Determines which renderer is being used.

## SETTINGS_RESOLUTION_INFO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_RESOLUTION_INFO&lang=en)

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3450`

## SETTINGS_REFRESH_RATE_INFO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_REFRESH_RATE_INFO&lang=en)

### 中文

使用全屏幕模式时，§H刷新率§!决定了显示器的每秒重绘次数。在窗口化或无边框模式中，将采取桌面的刷新率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3302`

### English

When running in full screen mode, the §HRefresh Rate§! determines how many times per second your monitor will redraw the screen. In Windowed or Borderless mode, the refresh rate of your desktop will be used.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3451`

## SETTINGS_MULTISAMPLE_INFO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_MULTISAMPLE_INFO&lang=en)

### 中文

§H多重采样§!会在渲染时平滑锯齿边缘。设置得越高，占用资源越多，但也会带来更好的画面表现。使用较老的硬件时，将该值设为0来提高性能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3303`

### English

§HMultisampling§! smooths jagged edges during rendering. A higher value will produce a better result at the cost of performance. Set this to 0 if running on older hardware to improve performance.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3452`

## SETTINGS_GUISCALE

## SETTINGS_GUISCALE_INFO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_GUISCALE_INFO&lang=en)

### 中文

§H用户界面缩放§!的最大值取决于你的§H分辨率§!。分辨率越高，§H用户界面缩放§!就可以调的更高。请注意勿将此值设置得过高，否则部分用户界面要素会超出屏幕，无法使用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3305`

### English

Maximum §HUI Scaling§! depends on your §HResolution§!. Higher resolutions will allow a higher §HUI Scaling§!. Take care not to use too high values, or UI elements may become inaccessible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3454`

## SETTINGS_EVENT_AUTO_PAUSE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_EVENT_AUTO_PAUSE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$SETTINGS_AUTO_PAUSE_LABEL$§!\n若如果设为§Y开启§!，每当事件触发时游戏都会自动暂停。$DEFAULT_BRACKET$\n$SEPARATOR$\n§E特定信息可能启用§H自动暂停§!功能，即便该设置为§Y关闭§!也会暂停§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3368`

### English

§H$SETTINGS_AUTO_PAUSE_LABEL$§!\nIf set to §YOn§!, whenever an event is triggered, the game will automatically pause. $DEFAULT_BRACKET$\n$SEPARATOR$\n§ESpecific messages can have §HAuto-Pause§! enabled, even though this setting is set to §YOff§!§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3520`

## SETTINGS_EVENT_AUTO_UNPAUSE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_EVENT_AUTO_UNPAUSE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$SETTINGS_AUTO_UNPAUSE_LABEL$§!\n若§Y开启§!，游戏将在关闭所有导致暂停的信息弹窗之后自动继续。$DEFAULT_BRACKET$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:3369`

### English

§H$SETTINGS_AUTO_UNPAUSE_LABEL$§!\nIf §YOn§!, the game automatically resumes after closing all message popups that paused it. $DEFAULT_BRACKET$

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:3521`

## SETTINGS_EVENT_POPUP_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASETTINGS_EVENT_POPUP_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$SETTINGS_EVENT_POPUP_LABEL$§!\n若设为§Y开启§!，事件将会自动跳出。$DEFAULT_BRACKET$\n若设为§Y关闭§!，所有事件都会变成提示，仅当点击时打开。

### English

Exotic Gases

## exotic_gases_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aexotic_gases_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

罕见的异星天然气拥有各种用途，主要是用来为高级能量武器和能量力场提供能源。部分也用作舰船燃料或消遣性毒品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4140`

### English

Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4355`

## rare_crystals

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arare_crystals&lang=en)

### English

## rare_crystals_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arare_crystals_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些水晶拥有独特的属性，非常适合用来凝聚和集中激光束，同时也是制作大部分高级电子器材的关键材料。部分文化也视之为装饰物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4142`

### English

These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4358`

## sr_zro_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asr_zro_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4147`

### English

An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4366`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asr_living_metal_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该无机金属有着通常生命体才具备的特征。会自动恢复到其被塑造好的形态。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4149`

### English

This inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4368`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asr_dark_matter_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种神秘物质具有许多似乎可以打破所谓自然法则的性质。该物质仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近才能达到可供开采的浓度。

### 中文

这些温顺的生物很容易被奴役，其友善的举止和可爱的外表让它们成为宠物的不二之选。亲外者们十分喜爱这些生物，并且自豪地在他们的动物园里展示。

## building_vault_desc

### 中文

这些帐篷标记了通向巨大地下避难所的入口，这个世界的原住民把它当作防空洞。当食物耗尽后，避难所的居民反目成仇。

这些帐篷标记了通向巨大地下避难所的入口，这个世界的原住民把它当作防空洞。这个避难所还包含一个巨大的机械停放处，以及许多售卖采矿设备的商店。

## building_probability_engine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_probability_engine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该异常强大的人工智能建筑体不断运行尖端的数学仿真，企图预测有机群落的未来行动。至少已经证实，它可以准确预测他们的股票市场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4606`

### English

This exceedingly powerful AI construct is constantly running advanced mathematical simulations in a vain attempt to predict the future actions of organic societies. It has proven adept at anticipating developments on their stock markets, however.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4846`

### English

Organic Sanctuary

## building_organic_sanctuary_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_organic_sanctuary_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该庇护所为有机生命提供安全成长的封闭环境，而且能完全监控他们的行为。居住于其中的有机体的住房需求将被完全满足。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4608`

### English

This sanctuary provides a sealed environment where organics can thrive in a safe and above all controlled manner. The organics within have their housing needs completely fulfilled.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4848`

## building_organic_paradise

### English

Organic Paradise

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4849`

## building_organic_paradise_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_organic_paradise_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个由人工智能控制的人造乐土，专门用于满足智慧有机生命的需求。当然，这其中不包括自主自决的需求。居住于其中的有机体的住房需求将被完全满足。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4610`

### English

An AI-controlled artificial paradise designed to satisfy every need a sapient organic being might have, just so long as it does not express a need for self-determination. The organics within have their housing needs completely fulfilled.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4850`

## building_trophy_vault

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_trophy_vault&lang=en)

### 中文

创造性展览舱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4611`

### English

Creativity Exhibition Vault

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4851`

## building_trophy_vault_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_trophy_vault_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

算法维系着活体陈设源源不断的创意输出，筛选统计显著的情感共鸣。虽然客观上缺乏技术价值，但这些表达被保留为社会情感验证的手段，并提供自决的幻觉。由此产生的满意度值的增加是非常重要的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4612`

### English

Algorithms maintain a curated rotation of Bio-Trophy creative outputs, selected for their statistically significant emotional resonance. While objectively devoid of technical merit, these expressions are preserved as a means of socio-emotional validation and to provide the illusion of self-determination. The resulting increase in satisfaction metrics is non-trivial.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4852`

## building_trophy_vault_forever_cruise_effect

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_trophy_vault_forever_cruise_effect&lang=en)

### 中文

£job_cruise_passenger£$job_cruise_passenger_bio_trophy_plural$获得更高的£unity£凝聚力产出、£consumer_goods£消费品维护费以及幸福度。\n£job_cruise_passenger_unemployment£$job_cruise_passenger_unemployment_bio_trophy_plural$获得更高的£unity£凝聚力产出和£consumer_goods£消费品维护费。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4613`

### English

£job_cruise_passenger£ $job_cruise_passenger_bio_trophy_plural$ receive the increased £unity£ Unity production, £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods upkeep, and Happiness.\n£job_cruise_passenger_unemployment£ $job_cruise_passenger_unemployment_bio_trophy_plural$ receive the increased £unity£ Unity production and £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods upkeep.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4853`

### 中文

这个设施使用多种工业生物产品合成一种可以为有机生物充当良好营养源的酱膏。在化学调剂品的辅助下，这种酱膏可以模拟出多种美食的风味。至少七成的有机生物都无法分辨其中的不同。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4615`

### English

This facility uses various industrial bi-products to create a thick paste that is an excellent source of nutrients for organics. With the addition of chemical flavoring, the paste can be molded into approximations of most prepared food compositions. Seven out of ten organics can't tell the difference.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4855`

## auth_hive_mind_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_hive_mind_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

蜂群思维的运作更像是一个单一生物体，而非一个国家。其人口没有自由意志，作为格式塔意识本身的延伸而行动，就如同躯体的四肢一般。\n\n一旦与主脑断开连接，这些子个体便会陷入昏迷，并最终衰竭而亡。在主脑占据的星球上，任何自由个体都会被驱逐、杀害，或者干脆被当作猎物来喂养整个集体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4642`

### English

Hive Minds operate as a single organism more than as a state. The population has no free will, and act as an extension of the gestalt consciousness itself, much like the limbs of a body.\n\nWhen cut off from the Mind, these drones become comatose and eventually wither and die. Any free individuals on planets owned by the Mind are driven away, killed, or simply treated as prey to feed the collective.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4885`

## auth_machine_intelligence_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aauth_machine_intelligence_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

机械智能是庞大的人工群体心智，它们被联网融合成了一个单一的格式塔意识。在这种帝国中，绝大多数实际的“人口”由无意识的工作单元组成，它们只会执行被指派的任务，没有任何自由意志可言。\n\n通常会分配少量的半自主个体来执行更为专业的任务，因为一定程度的独立主动性有助于更好地完成这些任务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:4649`

### English

Machine Intelligences are immense artificial group minds that have been networked into a single gestalt consciousness. Most of the actual "population" in such an empire consists of mindless work units who perform their designated tasks without any semblance of free will.\n\nA small number of semi-autonomous agents are typically employed for more specialized tasks that benefit from some degree of independent initiative.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:4892`

## martial_empire_desc

§L这种政体是一种高级的军国主义专制独裁政体，国家的大部分存在意义就是为了大力支援军事事务。人们重视军事才能，同时所有公民都会定期进行军事训练。§!

### 中文

由极端排外思想发展出的一种世袭独裁制度，而君主的最终职责便是确保所有玷污永恒寰宇的低等物种彻底从这个位面上消失。

它是在黑暗社会中绽放光明的灯塔。自由和民主在这里受到最高的尊崇。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5032`

## civic_exalted_priesthood

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_exalted_priesthood&lang=en)

## civic_exalted_priesthood_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_exalted_priesthood_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了防止异端的侵入，我们选择让社会中一群最智慧、最虔诚的神职人员组成的宗教委员会来治理我们的国家。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5034`

### English

To guard against heresy, this society is ruled by a religious council consisting of the wisest and most pious members of the clergy.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5286`

## civic_philosopher_king

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_philosopher_king&lang=en)

哲人王

### English

Philosopher King

## civic_philosopher_king_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_philosopher_king_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

仅仅依靠普通的统治是不够的，政府必须由一个拥有足够智慧和知识的王者来领导它们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5036`

### English

It is not enough to simply rule. The Ship of State must be guided by a king that wields enough wisdom and knowledge to steer it true.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5288`

## civic_meritocracy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_meritocracy&lang=en)

### 中文

精英政治

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5037`

### English

Meritocracy

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5289`

## civic_meritocracy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_meritocracy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个人的个人社会地位或他的人际关系跟他所处的职业没有任何关联。天资和能力才是使社会进步的唯一基础。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5038`

### English

An individual's social station or personal connections should have no bearing on their profession. The sole basis for advancement in this society is demonstrated ability and talent.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5290`

## civic_citizen_service

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_citizen_service&lang=en)

### 中文

公民兵役

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5039`

### English

Citizen Service

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5291`

## civic_citizen_service_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_citizen_service_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你是否履行了自己的责任？只有那些在军队服役完成了政治责任的人才能拥有完整公民权的。服役保障公民权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5040`

### English

Are you doing your part? Full citizenship and the political responsibility that comes with it is limited to those who have served a tour of duty in the military. Service guarantees citizenship.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5292`

## civic_technocracy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_technocracy&lang=en)

### 中文

技术治国

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5041`

### English

Technocracy

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5293`

## civic_technocracy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_technocracy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了最大限度地提高效率，该社会将科学和理性作为行事准则。那些无知的、危险的、不合格的政治精英们的个人妄想绝对不能介入。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5042`

### English

To maximize efficiency, this society is governed according to the principles of science and rationality. The personal whims of an ignorant and dangerously unqualified political elite must not be allowed to interfere.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5294`

## civic_police_state

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_police_state&lang=en)

### 中文

警察国度

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5043`

### English

Police State

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5295`

## civic_police_state_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_police_state_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不留痕迹的消除任何异议，在这个压抑的社会中，人们的一言一行都被庞大的内部警力仔细的控制监视着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5044`

### English

To quash any traces of dissent, the population in this repressive society is carefully monitored and controlled by a large internal police force.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5296`

## civic_idealistic_foundation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_idealistic_foundation&lang=en)

### 中文

理想本心

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5045`

### English

Idealistic Foundation

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5297`

## civic_idealistic_foundation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_idealistic_foundation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

建立在强大的理想主义价值观之上的社会。无论当前政府是否对此抱予信任，人们心中永远抱有对美好未来的向往。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5046`

### English

This society was founded on strong idealistic values. Whether the current government remains true to them or not, the people have not forgotten.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5298`

Environmentalist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_environmentalist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个社会寻求如何与自然和谐相处之道。非常谨慎地保护环境，尽可能的限制消费。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5048`

### English

This society seeks to co-exist in harmony with nature. Great care is taken to preserve the environment and limit consumerism where possible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5300`

## civic_slaver_guilds

社会中真正的权力核心在于一些强大而无情的奴贩公会。他们懂得如何从一个奴隶身上榨取更多。

### 中文

这个安静平和的社会不愿意接受不懂得他们生活方式的外来者。比起外界的一切，他们更乐于留在自己的世外桃源不受打扰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5053`

This calm and pacifist society has little use for strangers who do not understand its way of life. More than anything, these people would prefer to be left alone.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5305`

## civic_warrior_culture

这个社会已经发展处一种强悍的武士精神。武功战力高于一切，只有在战场上才能获得真正的荣耀。

## civic_distinguished_admiralty_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_distinguished_admiralty_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

舰队和海军实力在政界有着极为突出的影响力。他们会有选择性的招募精锐的新兵到他们中来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5057`

### English

The Fleet and the Admiralty have unusually prominent roles in this society, wielding a great deal of influence in political circles. They have the pick of the litter when it comes to new military recruits.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5309`

## civic_free_haven

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_free_haven&lang=en)

### 中文

自由庇护所

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5058`

### English

Free Haven

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5310`

## civic_free_haven_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_free_haven_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种社会被人们称赞为自由的庇护所。不论是何物种、出身贵贱，那些辛劳的、贫穷的、渴望呼吸到自由空气的人们在这里都会受到欢迎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5059`

### English

This society has a well-earned reputation as a free haven. The tired, the poor, the huddled masses yearning to breathe free - all are welcome here, regardless of their species or origin.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5311`

## civic_cutthroat_politics

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_cutthroat_politics&lang=en)

### 中文

面具帝国

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5060`

### English

Cutthroat Politics

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5312`

## civic_cutthroat_politics_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_cutthroat_politics_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种政治制度因其阴谋权术而闻名于世。权力斗争、阴暗的背后交易和密谋策划是理所当然的。然而，那些游戏经验丰富的玩家能更好的掌控它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5061`

### English

The political system in this society is renowned for its intrigue. Power struggles, shady backroom deals and cloak and dagger scheming are par for the course. Those who survive long enough to learn the game, however, tend to learn it well.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5313`

## civic_corporate_dominion

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_corporate_dominion&lang=en)

### 中文

企业国度

### English

Corporate Dominion

## civic_corporate_dominion_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_corporate_dominion_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个社会由一家寰宇企业支配，后者已经完全代替了国家的上层建筑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5063`

### English

This society is dominated by a megacorporation that has completely supplanted the role of the state.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5315`

## civic_agrarian_idyll

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_agrarian_idyll&lang=en)

### 中文

田园牧歌

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5064`

### English

Agrarian Idyll

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5316`

## civic_agrarian_idyll_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_agrarian_idyll_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个简单而平凡的生活环境往往好处多多。该农业社会在很大程度上设法避免大规模城市化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5065`

### English

A simple and peaceful life can often be the most rewarding. This agrarian society has, to a large extent, managed to avoid large-scale urbanization.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5317`

## civic_shadow_council

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_shadow_council&lang=en)

### 中文

影子内阁

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5066`

### English

Shadow Council

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5318`

## civic_shadow_council_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_shadow_council_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

连自己的国民都不知道，这个社会其实是由一个幕后操控一切的影子内阁统治的。民主的外表必须维持，但是多数专制也得到保留。毕竟，万一有傻子投票给错误的候选人呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5067`

### English

Unbeknownst to its own citizens, this society is actually manipulated from behind the scenes by a secretive shadow council. Appearances must be kept, but the tyranny of the majority should also be guarded against. After all, what if the fools vote for the wrong candidate?

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5319`

## civic_mining_guilds

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_mining_guilds&lang=en)

### 中文

矿业公会

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5068`

### English

Mining Guilds

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5320`

## civic_mining_guilds_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_mining_guilds_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一些大型矿业公会已经占据了社会中的主导地位。政府严重依赖他们的支持。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5069`

### English

Several large mining guilds have reached a dominant position in this society. The government relies heavily on their support.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5321`

## civic_parliamentary_system

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_parliamentary_system&lang=en)

### 中文

议会制度

### English

Parliamentary System

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5322`

## civic_parliamentary_system_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_parliamentary_system_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该社会的议会制度鼓励言论自由和激烈的讨论。事实证明，巴结一个占据主导地位的政府派系是非常有用的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5071`

### English

The parliamentary system in this society encourages a free and lively debate. Currying favor with one of the dominant political factions can prove to be quite advantageous.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5323`

## civic_efficient_bureaucracy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_efficient_bureaucracy&lang=en)

### 中文

高效吏治

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5072`

### English

Efficient Bureaucracy

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5324`

## civic_efficient_bureaucracy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_efficient_bureaucracy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该社会以高效著称。我们不仅列车准点，运行一个星际国家所需要的庞大的官僚机器也如流水线般精确运作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5073`

### English

This society is renowned for its efficiency. Not only do the mag-trains run on time, but the colossal bureaucratic apparatus required to run an interstellar nation has been greatly streamlined.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5325`

## civic_nationalistic_zeal

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_nationalistic_zeal&lang=en)

### 中文

国民主义热忱

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_nationalistic_zeal_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

强烈的国民自豪感渗透进该社会的各个层面。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5075`

### English

A strong sense of nationalistic pride permeates all layers of this society.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5327`

## civic_functional_architecture

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_functional_architecture&lang=en)

### 中文

实用建筑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5076`

### English

Functional Architecture

## civic_functional_architecture_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_functional_architecture_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该社会以简单而实用的建筑结构而闻名。有些人把这种建筑风格评价为无趣甚至让人抑郁，但在大多数情况下，新型水泥并不比其它建筑材料差。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5077`

### English

This society is renowned for its simple yet functional architecture. There are those who would refer to this building style as boring or even depressing, but in most cases, neo-concrete does the job just as well as any other building material.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5329`

### 中文

某个根深蒂固的贵族团体统治着整个社会的上层阶级。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5080`

### English

This society has an entrenched nobility that occupies the upper echelons of society.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5332`

## civic_mechanists

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_mechanists&lang=en)

### 中文

机械师

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5081`

### English

Mechanist

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5333`

## civic_mechanists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_mechanists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

社会专注于机械人制造的风潮始于蒸汽时代。尽管许多人说这是不可能的，但是事实上，真正意义上的机器人早在太空飞行之前就离开装配线了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5082`

### English

This society has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5334`

## civic_syncretic_evolution

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_syncretic_evolution&lang=en)

### 中文

协同进化

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5083`

### English

Syncretic Evolution

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5335`

## civic_syncretic_evolution_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_syncretic_evolution_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

第二物种是这个社会不可分割的一部分。他们又大又强壮，但大多数的智力跟弱智的孩童差不多。在古代战争中我们将他们好斗的一面剔除了，这让他们变成了最听话的仆人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5084`

### English

A second species forms an integral part of this society. They are big, strong and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5336`

## civic_syncretic_evolution_secondary_species

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_syncretic_evolution_secondary_species&lang=en)

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_shared_burden&lang=en)

### English

## civic_shared_burden_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_shared_burden_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

此社会信奉资源均匀分配的理念，无论是统治阶层还是被统治阶层都理应获得一视同仁的对待。所有人会为社会的整体而努力奋斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5087`

### English

This society believes in an equitable distribution of resources, making little to no distinction between the needs of ruler and ruled. All work together for the benefit of the whole.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5339`

## civic_fanatic_purifiers

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_fanatic_purifiers&lang=en)

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_fanatic_purifiers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个社会似乎会不顾一切地净化所有星系中其他的智慧生命。不管发生什么，他们都不会容忍异族的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5089`

### English

This society appears hellbent on scouring the galaxy of all other sapient life. Come what may, they will suffer no xenos to live.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5341`

这个社会毫无秩序可言。战斗就是活下去的意义，最强者就可以掌握最强的权力。

## civic_byzantine_bureaucracy

### English

Byzantine Bureaucracy

## civic_byzantine_bureaucracy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_byzantine_bureaucracy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

此社会是由非常复杂的，对于外人而言简直就是迷宫一般的行政体制所统治。为了维持政府的流畅运作，大量的公职人员会日以继夜地工作以确保所有公民只获得跟其能力与资格相匹配的资源分配。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5216`

### English

This society is largely governed by a complex and, to the outsider, almost labyrinthine system of bureaucracy. An army of officials and functionaries work tirelessly to keep the government running smoothly and ensure no citizens are allocated resources they cannot demonstrate a properly filed and triple-stamped need for.

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5468`

商人公会

### English

Merchant Guilds

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_franchising_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

此寰宇企业政权格外依赖于特许经营。在此制度下，各个附属公司需要向企业霸主缴纳更高比率的利润，好处是可以获得该企业品牌的特许经营权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5220`

商机是需要靠自己挖掘的。这个寰宇企业长久以来通过建立贸易站来散播自己的影响力。企业的恒星基地向来都身兼繁忙的贸易中心的功能。

打造更美好的世界是很高风险的工作，所以此寰宇企业是通过民间勘探者为公司勘探有发展潜力的边境行星并在当地建立先遣基地。

此寰宇企业旗下拥有大量的私营军事公司。这些雇佣兵性质的承包商公司在必要时会为该企业提供实力强大的地面部队。

若你能控制别人的思想，你也就控制了他们的行为。这家寰宇企业拥有一支由专家组成的虚拟网军，时刻准备着在公共舆论的战场上重拳出击。

## civic_death_cult_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_death_cult_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该团体的宗教建立在周期性的祭献秘仪之上。自愿奉献的先行者花费整整十年全身心地投入到研习之中，然后在仪式中舍身赴死，他们的死亡使得整个群体的文化繁荣昌盛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_2_l_simp_chinese.yml:5249`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_2_l_english.yml:5501`

### 中文

这一寰宇企业将祭献秘仪作为获得持续性利润的手段。自愿奉献的先行者们每隔一段时间就会选出代表奉献出自己的生命，以期国富民强。

### English

## allow_crossbreeding

### 中文

Additionally, crossbreeding between different species living on the same colony will pool their growth potential together!
